name: essential meiotic structure-specific endonuclease 1

function.text: EME1 encodes structure-specific endonuclease subunit EME1. It participates in double-strand break repair and replication fork processing.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
